text: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) combines a retriever that fetches relevant documents with a generator that produces answers grounded in those documents. RAG reduces hallucination by constraining the LLM to retrieved context.

An AI agent is a system that uses an LLM to decide which tools to call in a loop until a goal is reached. Tools can be search, calculator, or external APIs. Agents must handle tool errors and produce structured output.

Chroma is a local vector database for storing embeddings. It supports persistent storage and similarity search via cosine distance. Chroma is often used for prototyping RAG pipelines before migrating to Qdrant or Weaviate.

FastAPI is a modern Python web framework with automatic OpenAPI documentation. It uses Pydantic for request validation and supports async endpoints, making it a common choice for machine learning and LLM backends.
Pydantic v2 provides data validation and settings management using Python type hints. BaseModel defines schemas, and BaseSettings reads from environment variables and .env files.
Ragas is a framework for evaluating retrieval augmented generation pipelines. It computes faithfulness, answer relevancy, and context precision using an LLM as judge against ground-truth datasets.

Idempotency means running an operation multiple times has the same effect as running it once. In ingestion pipelines, idempotency is achieved with a stable key such as a content hash combined with a version tag.

Text chunking splits documents into smaller pieces that fit within embedding and LLM context windows. Recursive chunking respects paragraph and sentence boundaries, producing more coherent chunks than fixed-size splitting.
Docker packages an application and its dependencies into a container image. Multi-stage builds keep runtime images small by separating build-time tooling from the final layer.
Continuous integration runs linters, type checkers, and tests automatically on every push. GitHub Actions is a common CI provider that reads workflow YAML files from .github/workflows.
LangGraph models an agent as a state machine of nodes and edges. It supports cycles, which are needed for tool-calling loops where the agent decides whether to call another tool or finish.
A correlation identifier is a unique value attached to a request so that all log lines and traces related to it can be grouped. It is commonly propagated via an HTTP header such as X-Request-ID.
